'''Qwen3.8-27B''' is a dense 27.8B vision-language model with a hybrid linear/full attention design.<ref>[https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B Qwen3.8-27B model card]</ref> It ships as one post-trained checkpoint with thinking on by default; thinking can be turned off per request. No Base checkpoint is published.

== Browser ability today ==
The card reports '''64.8 on WebArena-Verified''', against 48.8 for Qwen3.6-27B. That starting point is strong. General web gains from RL will be smaller than for a 4B model. The gains on our own tool interface and tasks are still unmeasured, and they are what the [[roadmap]] targets.

== In this project ==
* Fits a single [[dgx-spark|Spark]] for training in BF16 (~56 GB of weights).
* Estimated 150-step run: ~5 days with [[rtx-pro-6000|PRO 6000s]] generating and Sparks training, ~2 days on the PRO 6000s alone, ~9.5 days on Sparks alone. See [[run-time]].
* OpenPipe ART's notebooks use this model, so [[openpipe-art|ART]] is a well-trodden path.<ref>[https://github.com/OpenPipe/ART OpenPipe ART repository]</ref>
* Thinking on means long outputs. Train with thinking off, or a low budget, to keep [[rollout|rollouts]] short.
